text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Cheers from the crowd echo throughout the paddock, but Tamamo Cross and Super Creek aren't the only names they're calling out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They're also cheering for Oguri Cap, the beast from the boonies, and she's filled with a renewed sense of determination.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The climactic showdown is about to commence, and everyone's hopes are on the line.
